/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip
from Bio.Seq import Seq

def get_range(fn,target,start,end,strand):
    with gzip.open(fn,'rt') as f:
        name=None; seq=[]
        for line in f:
            if line.startswith('>'):
                if name==target:
                    break
                name=line[1:].split()[0]
                seq=[]
            elif name==target:
                seq.append(line.strip())
        s=''.join(seq)
    print(fn,target,'seqlen',len(s),'range',start,end,'strand',strand)
    sub=s[start-1:end]
    if strand=='-':
        sub=str(Seq(sub).reverse_complement())
    return sub

i=get_range('indri.fna.gz','CAUYTU010176261.1',17146,17445,'+')
s=get_range('semjoh.fna.gz','CAUYPG010105159.1',30208,30507,'-')
print('indri len',len(i),i[:30],i[-30:])
print('sem len',len(s),s[:30],s[-30:])
print('match blast indri',i== '')
print('match blast sem',s== '')
PY"
